title: harness: codex-spec-gate (non-mini codex needs SPEC block)
desc: Blocks codex exec (non-mini models) without a 5-item SPEC block. Prevents underspecified Codex runs that exit early or produce wrong output.
steps: SAFETY: Fires on 'codex exec' without --model codex-mini when the command lacks 'SPEC:' plus numbered items 1-5. Non-mini Codex is expensive; underspecified prompts cause early exit with partial results or wrong output.
SOLUTION: Add a SPEC block with exactly 5 items: SPEC: 1.Goal 2.Files 3.Approach 4.Constraints 5.Exit. OR switch to --model codex-mini which is exempt from this gate (it is the default cheap model).

PREVENTION: Always write a SPEC block for non-mini Codex runs. The exit criterion (item 5) is the most important -- Codex stops when it thinks it is done, so a vague goal causes premature exit. Use wkcodex.sh for standard tasks (auto-validates and defaults to codex-mini).
author: claude
